en.title: Best Streaming Devices 2026: Ranked by What You Own After You Pay
en.description: Ten 4K streaming boxes and sticks ranked on home screen ad load, viewing-data collection, app freedom and codec support, in the year Apple raised the Apple TV 4K by 54% and Amazon closed Fire TV behind Vega OS.

zh-tw.title: 2026 最佳電視盒排行榜：付完錢之後你真正拿到什麼
zh-tw.description: 10 款 4K 電視盒與電視棒，用首頁廣告量、觀看資料蒐集、App 自由度與編碼支援排名。今年 Apple 把 Apple TV 4K 漲了 54%，Amazon 則把 Fire TV 收進自家的 Vega OS。

en.description: The one premium streamer that held its price through the 2026 memory crunch, with AV1 decode, 32GB of storage, gigabit Ethernet and a Thread border router that makes it a Matter hub for the whole house.

zh-tw.description: 這波記憶體漲價裡唯一價格沒動的高階盒子，AV1 解碼、32GB 儲存、Gigabit 網路孔，內建 Thread 邊界路由器可以直接當全家的 Matter 中樞。

en.description: The fastest and quietest interface in the category, with zero home screen advertising and no content recognition layer, now carrying a price Apple raised 54% in June 2026 on unchanged silicon.

zh-tw.description: 介面最順、最安靜的一台，首頁沒有廣告也沒有內容辨識層，代價是 Apple 在 2026 年 6 月把它漲了 54%，機器內容一模一樣。

en.description: Fifty dollars buys 3GB of RAM, 32GB of storage, a gigabit Ethernet port, Dolby Vision, Atmos, AV1 decode and a physical find-my-remote button, which is the most hardware per dollar on this page.

zh-tw.description: 五十美金給你 3GB RAM、32GB 儲存、Gigabit 網路孔、Dolby Vision、Atmos、AV1 解碼，機身頂上還有一顆找遙控器的實體鍵，這頁 CP 值最高的一台。

en.description: Google TV on a 6nm chip with 32GB of storage, Wi-Fi 6, HDMI 2.1, Dolby Vision and Atmos, sold through official channels in most of Asia and Europe with a local warranty attached.

zh-tw.description: 6 奈米晶片跑 Google TV，32GB 儲存、Wi-Fi 6、HDMI 2.1、Dolby Vision 加 Atmos，台灣有公司貨有保固，NT$1,399 這個價位在台灣沒有對手。

en.description: The calmest interface to navigate and the best remote in this group, with Dolby Vision, Atmos, Wi-Fi 6 and an Ethernet port, funded by an advertising business that supplies over 70% of Roku's revenue.

zh-tw.description: 這群裡介面最好操作、遙控器做得最紮實的一台，Dolby Vision、Atmos、Wi-Fi 6 加實體網路孔，背後撐著它的是佔 Roku 七成以上營收的廣告生意。

en.description: Still the most capable Fire stick Amazon sells, running Android-based Fire OS with Wi-Fi 6E, 16GB of storage, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, Atmos and AV1 decode, and it accepts sideloaded apps.

zh-tw.description: Amazon 目前最完整的那一支 Fire 棒，跑 Android 底的 Fire OS，Wi-Fi 6E、16GB 儲存、Dolby Vision、HDR10+、Atmos 加 AV1 解碼，而且還能側載 App。

en.description: Roku's 2025 redesign is over 35% smaller than the sticks it replaces, draws power from the TV's USB port and delivers clean 4K HDR10 for forty dollars with the full Roku channel library.

zh-tw.description: Roku 2025 年重新設計的版本，體積比上一代小三成五以上，直接吃電視的 USB 供電，四十美金給你乾淨的 4K HDR10 跟完整的 Roku 頻道庫。

en.description: An octa-core box that doubles as an Echo speaker, with Wi-Fi 6E, gigabit Ethernet, an HDMI input for a cable box and hands-free Alexa that answers from across the room.

zh-tw.description: 八核心的盒子同時也是一台 Echo 音箱，Wi-Fi 6E、Gigabit 網路孔、還有一個 HDMI 輸入可以串第四台機上盒，免持 Alexa 隔著客廳喊也聽得到。

en.description: Amazon's first device on Vega OS, its own Linux platform, streaming 4K with HDR10 and HDR10+ for forty dollars from a catalogue of Vega apps that Amazon curates and ships.

zh-tw.description: Amazon 第一台跑自家 Linux 系統 Vega OS 的裝置，四十美金串 4K 加 HDR10、HDR10+，App 清單是 Amazon 審過並上架的 Vega App。

en.description: The Plex and GeForce Now machine, with 3GB of RAM, 16GB of storage, two USB ports for external drives and AI upscaling that still holds up on 1080p sources seven years after launch.

zh-tw.description: 跑 Plex 跟 GeForce Now 的那一台，3GB RAM、16GB 儲存、兩個 USB 可以外接硬碟，AI 升頻拿來救 1080p 片源到現在還是有用，上市七年了。

en.commentary:
The streaming box market split into two economies this year, and the split decides what you should buy. On one side are the ad funded devices. Roku takes more than 70% of its revenue from advertising, and CEO Anthony Wood has confirmed video ads are coming to the home screen across Roku players and Roku TVs. Amazon shipped the Fire TV Stick 4K Select on 15 October 2025 running Vega OS, its own Linux platform, where the app catalogue is the one Amazon approves and ships. Walmart sells the onn 4K Pro for around fifty dollars with gigabit Ethernet, Dolby Vision, Atmos and AV1 decode, hardware that carried a $150 price tag in 2022. These devices keep getting cheaper because the box is the cheapest part of the business model.

On the other side are the devices you pay for outright, and those moved the opposite way. Apple lifted the Apple TV 4K from $129 to $199 on 25 June 2026, and the Ethernet model from $149 to $249, with the same A15 Bionic and the same storage inside. Taiwan's Apple store now lists NT$6,900 and NT$8,500. Apple pointed at the memory shortage driven by AI data centre demand, and I believe that explanation. I also think the timing makes this the worst month of 2026 to hand over the money, because Bloomberg and every credible leak put an A17 Pro refresh with Wi-Fi 7 and Thread at Apple's autumn event.

My pick is the Google TV Streamer at $99. It gives you AV1 decode, 32GB of storage, a real gigabit jack and a Thread border router, and Google held that price flat straight through the memory crunch. Take the onn 4K Pro if you want most of that for half the money. If you are shopping in Taiwan and you want a local warranty and a receipt, the Xiaomi TV Box S 3rd Gen at NT$1,399 is the one I recommend to family.

highlights.title: Apple picked the worst possible month to ask NT$6,900 for a 2022 box
highlights.body: The Apple TV 4K runs the fastest and quietest interface in this category, and on hardware alone I would rank it first. Price is where it falls. Apple moved the Wi-Fi model from $129 to $199 on 25 June 2026 and the Wi-Fi plus Ethernet model from $149 to $249, jumps of 54% and 67% on a device that launched in October 2022 with the A15 Bionic. Taiwan's store now lists NT$6,900 and NT$8,500, which in Taipei is entry-level 4K television money for a set-top box. Bloomberg reporting and the hardware leaks agree that an A17 Pro model with Wi-Fi 7, Thread and the rebuilt Siri lands at Apple's autumn event. Wait the few weeks.

highlights.title: The $50 onn 4K Pro packs more hardware per dollar than anything else here
highlights.body: Walmart's 2026 onn 4K Pro carries 3GB of RAM, 32GB of storage, a gigabit Ethernet port, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, AV1 decode, hands-free voice and a physical find-my-remote button on the top of the case, at $49.88 in grey and $59.88 in black. The Google TV Streamer sitting above it adds 1GB of RAM and a Thread radio for twice the money. In my testing the onn lands app launches within about a second of boxes costing four times as much, which is close enough that the gap stops mattering on a sofa. The limit is distribution, since Walmart sells it in the United States and a Taiwanese buyer pays a forwarder on top.

highlights.title: Vega OS makes the cheapest Fire TV a sealed appliance, so price that in before you buy
highlights.body: The Fire TV Stick 4K Select launched on 15 October 2025 at $39.99 as the first Fire device running Vega OS, the Linux platform Amazon built to take over from the Android Open Source Project underneath Fire OS. Every app on it is a Vega app that Amazon approved and shipped, so your catalogue is exactly the list Amazon chooses to carry, and a VPN belongs on your router instead. It streams 4K with HDR10 and HDR10+, and for forty dollars it does that job well. Go in knowing you are buying Amazon's app list and Amazon's home screen for the life of the device.

highlights.title: Roku's home screen is an ad surface, and the switches you want sit three menus deep
highlights.body: Roku earns more than 70% of its revenue from advertising, and Anthony Wood has confirmed home screen video ads are rolling out across Roku players and Roku TVs. The automatic content recognition layer identifies what plays through every input, HDMI and antenna included, and feeds a viewing profile to advertisers and measurement partners. Every piece of that is switchable. Settings, then Privacy, then Smart TV Experience turns ACR off, and the Advertising panel enables Limit Ad Tracking. I still place the Roku Ultra fifth at $99.99, because the interface is the easiest in this group to hand to a parent and the remote is the best built of the ten.

zh-tw.commentary:
今年電視盒市場裂成兩塊，你該買哪一台，其實看你站在哪一邊。

一邊是靠廣告養的機器。Roku 超過七成營收來自廣告，執行長 Anthony Wood 已經確認首頁影片廣告會推到 Roku 播放器跟 Roku TV 上。Amazon 在 2025 年 10 月 15 日推的 Fire TV Stick 4K Select 跑自家的 Vega OS，上面的 App 清單由 Amazon 審核並上架。Walmart 的 onn 4K Pro 賣五十美金就給你 Gigabit 網路孔、Dolby Vision、Atmos 跟 AV1 解碼，這組規格在 2022 年的標價是一百五十美金。這些機器每年都在變便宜，因為盒子本身是這門生意裡最便宜的一環。

另一邊是你真的掏錢買硬體的那種，方向完全相反。Apple 在 2026 年 6 月 25 日把 Apple TV 4K 從 129 美金拉到 199，Ethernet 版從 149 拉到 249，機器裡面維持 2022 年那顆 A15 Bionic 跟同樣的容量。台灣官網現在掛 NT$6,900 跟 NT$8,500，說真的，一台機上盒開到快七千，我按不下去。Apple 的說法是 AI 資料中心把記憶體價格炒上去，這個理由我信。同時我也認為這個月是 2026 年最不該掏錢的時間點，因為 Bloomberg 跟各路爆料都指向 A17 Pro 改版加上 Wi-Fi 7 跟 Thread 會在秋季發表會登場。

我的第一名給 Google TV Streamer，99 美金有 AV1 解碼、32GB 儲存、實體 Gigabit 網路孔跟 Thread 邊界路由器，而且它在這波記憶體漲價裡價格一動也沒動。想省錢就挑 onn 4K Pro，一半的錢拿到大部分的東西。在台灣買、想要保固跟發票的話，小米電視盒子S 3代 NT$1,399 是我會直接推給家人的那一台。

highlights.title: 一台 2022 年的盒子在台灣要 NT$6,900，這個月真的先別下手
highlights.body: Apple TV 4K 的介面順度跟安靜程度，在我用過的電視盒裡面排第一，這點我很有把握。問題出在錢。6 月 25 日 Wi-Fi 版從 129 美金變 199、Wi-Fi 加 Ethernet 版從 149 變 249，漲幅是 54% 跟 67%，機器本體還是 2022 年 10 月上市那顆 A15 Bionic。台灣官網現在掛 NT$6,900 跟 NT$8,500，這個價位在台北已經摸得到一台入門 4K 電視了。Bloomberg 的報導跟硬體爆料都指向 A17 Pro、Wi-Fi 7、Thread 加上重寫過的 Siri 會在秋季發表會亮相，就再等幾週吧。

highlights.title: onn 4K Pro 五十美金的規格表，老實講有點誇張
highlights.body: Walmart 2026 這版 onn 4K Pro 給了 3GB RAM、32GB 儲存、Gigabit 網路孔、Dolby Vision、Dolby Atmos、AV1 解碼、免持語音，機殼頂上還做了一顆找遙控器的實體鍵，灰色 49.88 美金、黑色 59.88 美金。排在它上面的 Google TV Streamer 多了 1GB RAM 跟一顆 Thread 天線，價格是兩倍。我實測開 App 的速度，它跟四倍價格的機器差在一秒上下，坐在沙發上這個差距已經感覺不出來。真正的門檻在通路，它只在美國 Walmart 上架，台灣買家要多付一筆代購跟運費。

highlights.title: Vega OS 讓最便宜的 Fire TV 變成一台封閉家電，這件事要算進價格裡
highlights.body: Fire TV Stick 4K Select 在 2025 年 10 月 15 日以 39.99 美金上市，是第一台跑 Vega OS 的 Fire 裝置。Vega 是 Amazon 自己做的 Linux 系統，用來接手 Fire OS 底下的 Android 開源專案。上面每一支 App 都是 Amazon 審過並且上架的 Vega App，所以你看到的清單就是 Amazon 願意給你的那份清單，想用 VPN 的話請掛在路由器那一層。它串 4K 加 HDR10、HDR10+ 的表現，在四十美金這個價位算做得好的。買之前先知道，你買的是 Amazon 的 App 清單跟 Amazon 的首頁，而且這台機器的一輩子都是這樣。

highlights.title: Roku 的首頁就是一塊廣告版位，而那些開關全部關得掉
highlights.body: Roku 超過七成營收來自廣告，Anthony Wood 已經確認首頁影片廣告會推到 Roku 播放器跟 Roku TV 上。它的 ACR 會辨識每一個輸入來源播了什麼，HDMI 跟天線都算在內，然後把觀看輪廓送給廣告主與量測夥伴。這些全部都有開關。設定進去點隱私權，把 Smart TV Experience 關掉就是關 ACR，廣告那一欄再把 Limit Ad Tracking 打開。我還是把 Roku Ultra 排在第五，99.99 美金這台的介面是這十台裡面最能直接丟給爸媽用的，遙控器的做工也最紮實。

en.commentary:
No product news this week, so the ranking holds and I will say something about why the scores across this category are lower than most of the others on this site. Streaming boxes have become a market where the hardware is a delivery mechanism for advertising, and that shapes the products in ways that deserve to cost them points.

The Google TV Streamer 4K stays first at 8.6. It has the best hardware in the category, genuinely useful Chromecast integration, and Google Home functionality that works. It also puts a promotional row on your home screen, which is why an otherwise excellent device sits at 8.6 rather than 9.2.

The Apple TV 4K at 8.4 is the one I recommend to anyone who cares about interface quality above all. No advertising, the fastest interface in the group, and the best Dolby Vision implementation. It costs meaningfully more, and for people who use the device daily that premium buys a cleaner experience.

The onn 4K Pro at 8.3 is remarkable value and the sensible pick if the device is for a secondary television.

Before you buy anything, check whether your television already runs the platform you want. Many people buy a streaming box to escape a slow smart TV interface, which works, and many others buy one they did not need.

highlights.title: Scores are low here because advertising is built into the products
highlights.body: Streaming hardware has become a delivery mechanism for promotion, and that shapes the daily experience in ways that deserve to cost points. The Google TV Streamer has the best hardware in the category and sits at 8.6 specifically because of the promotional row on its home screen.

highlights.title: Apple TV 4K is the pick if interface quality matters most
highlights.body: No advertising, the fastest interface in the group, and the best Dolby Vision implementation. It costs meaningfully more, and for a device you touch every evening that premium buys a cleaner experience than anything else here offers.

highlights.title: Check what your television already runs first
highlights.body: Many people buy a streaming box to escape a slow smart TV interface, which is a completely valid reason. Many others buy one that duplicates what their set already does well. Five minutes checking your existing platform can save the purchase entirely.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週沒有產品新聞，排名維持不動，我想談談為什麼這個分類的分數比站上多數榜單都低。串流盒子已經變成一個「硬體是廣告投遞管道」的市場，而這件事會以應該被扣分的方式形塑產品。

Google TV Streamer 4K 以 8.6 分守住第一。它有這個分類最好的硬體、真正有用的 Chromecast 整合、以及能用的 Google Home 功能。它同時也在你的首頁放了一排推廣內容，這就是為什麼一台各方面都優秀的裝置停在 8.6 而非 9.2。

Apple TV 4K 的 8.4 分，是我推薦給「介面品質高於一切」的人。沒有廣告、介面是這群裡最快的、Dolby Vision 實作也最好。它明顯更貴，而對每天都在用這台裝置的人來說，那個溢價買到的是更乾淨的體驗。

onn 4K Pro 的 8.3 分 CP 值驚人，如果是給次要電視用的，它是很合理的選擇。

買任何東西之前，先確認你家電視是否已經內建你要的平台。很多人買串流盒子是為了逃離遲鈍的智慧電視介面，那完全成立，但也有很多人買了根本不需要的東西。

highlights.title: 這裡分數偏低，因為廣告被做進產品裡了
highlights.body: 串流硬體已經變成推廣的投遞管道，而這會以應該被扣分的方式形塑日常體驗。Google TV Streamer 有這個分類最好的硬體，停在 8.6 分正是因為首頁那一排推廣內容。

highlights.title: 介面品質最重要的話選 Apple TV 4K
highlights.body: 沒有廣告、介面是這群裡最快的、Dolby Vision 實作也最好。它明顯更貴，而對一台你每晚都會碰的裝置來說，那個溢價買到的乾淨體驗，這裡沒有別台給得起。

highlights.title: 先看你家電視已經跑什麼
highlights.body: 很多人買串流盒子是為了逃離遲鈍的智慧電視介面，那是完全成立的理由。也有很多人買了跟電視既有功能重複的東西。花五分鐘確認現有平台，可能就省下整筆開銷。

en.commentary:
Google TV Streamer holds first at 8.6 and I want to be honest about what a score in the eights means in this category. These are all competent boxes, and the scores sit lower than in categories where a product genuinely delights. Streaming hardware is infrastructure, and infrastructure earns points by staying out of the way.

The Google TV Streamer wins on the combination of a fast interface, Thread and Matter support that makes it useful as a smart home hub, and an app catalogue with no meaningful gaps. Apple TV 4K at 8.4 has the cleanest interface and the least advertising in the home screen, which matters more than the spec sheet suggests once you look at that screen several times a day. In an Apple household it is the obvious pick.

The onn. 4K Pro at 8.3 is the value answer and deserves more attention than it gets. It runs the same Google TV software on hardware costing a fraction of the leaders, and for a second television that is the correct decision.

My standing advice: check whether your television already runs software you can tolerate before buying any of these. A modern set with a recent platform often makes an external box redundant, and the honest recommendation is sometimes to spend nothing.

highlights.title: Infrastructure earns points by disappearing
highlights.body: Scores in the eights across this category are deliberate. A streaming box succeeds when you stop noticing it, which is a lower ceiling than products that genuinely delight.

highlights.title: Thread and Matter make one box do two jobs
highlights.body: The Google TV Streamer doubling as a smart home hub removes a separate purchase and a separate power socket. That dual role is what puts it on top of a tightly bunched field.

highlights.title: Home screen advertising is a daily tax
highlights.body: Apple TV 4K shows the least of it. You look at that screen several times a day, so a cleaner launcher matters more over a year than any specification on the box.

highlights.title: Check your television first
highlights.body: A recent set with a tolerable platform often makes an external box redundant. The honest recommendation in this category is sometimes to spend nothing at all.

zh-tw.commentary:
Google TV Streamer 守第一，8.6 分，我想誠實講一下這個品類拿八分區間是什麼意思。

這些盒子都很稱職，分數比那些真的會讓人驚喜的品類低。串流硬體是基礎設施，而基礎設施靠「不擋路」賺分數。

Google TV Streamer 贏在組合拳：介面順、支援 Thread 跟 Matter 所以能兼任智慧家庭集線器、App 目錄沒有實質缺口。

Apple TV 4K 的 8.4，介面最乾淨，首頁廣告最少，這件事的份量比規格表看起來重，畢竟你一天要看那個畫面好幾次。在蘋果生態系的家裡，它就是明顯答案。

onn. 4K Pro 的 8.3 是性價比解，值得比現在更多的關注。它跑的是同一套 Google TV 軟體，硬體價格卻只有前段班的零頭，拿來配第二台電視就是正確決定。

我長期的建議是，買這些之前先確認你的電視內建軟體你能不能忍。一台新一點、平台也還新的電視，常常讓外接盒變得多餘，而誠實的建議有時候就是一毛都別花。

highlights.title: 基礎設施靠消失來賺分數
highlights.body: 這個品類分數集中在八分區間是刻意的。串流盒成功的標準是你不再注意到它，這個天花板本來就低於會讓人驚喜的產品。

highlights.title: Thread 加 Matter 讓一台做兩件事
highlights.body: Google TV Streamer 兼任智慧家庭集線器，省掉一筆支出跟一個插座。這個雙重角色，就是它在緊咬的戰局裡站上頂端的原因。

highlights.title: 首頁廣告是每天都要繳的稅
highlights.body: Apple TV 4K 這方面最少。你一天看那個畫面好幾次，一整年下來，乾淨的啟動器比盒子上任何規格都重要。

highlights.title: 先看看你的電視
highlights.body: 平台還新、你也能接受的電視，常常讓外接盒變多餘。這個品類最誠實的建議，有時候是完全不用花錢。
